description: Запросы встроенному imagegen: пользовательские примеры задают четыре ракурса и логику; ApprovedHeroSource задаёт внешность. Idle использовал последние3 изображения, Walk последние4 (включая новый Idle).
idle: Use case: stylized-concept. Game asset: one 16-frame IDLE sprite sheet for FalseMemory. Input images 1 and 2 are the USER'S small RPG animation references: copy their FOUR cardinal camera directions, compact full-body framing, and standing animation logic. Input image3 is the actual FalseMemory HERO IDENTITY: keep this dark brown-haired hero, charcoal-black armor, burgundy scarf/cape, pale face, sword sheathed at his LEFT hip; NOT the blond example character. Create EXACTLY a 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW sprite sheet (16 figures total), preferably 1536x1536 or larger, transparent RGBA background, no text or dividers. Row1 DOWN front, Row2 LEFT profile looking toward image left, Row3 RIGHT profile looking toward image right, Row4 UP actual back view (back of hair and cape, NO face). Every row is exactly FOUR consecutive frames of a quiet standing/breathing LOOP. Columns: relaxed/low breath, gently inhale with shoulders and chest one or two pixels higher, highest small breath with cloak/hair subtle delayed movement, gently exhale toward first frame with a different slight trailing cloak contour. Both boots stay planted at the same x/y in ALL FOUR cells of each row. No walking or bent walking knees; no moving boot positions. Face, hair, armor pieces, sword-side, anatomy, proportions and colors stay consistent throughout. Preserve the approved hero's proportions and detailed dark fantasy PIXEL ART, crisp hand-placed pixel clusters, subdued palette, not glossy 3D/photorealistic rendering. Fixed orthographic-like top-down RPG view consistent with the user's references. Each cell same square canvas, hero same native pixel density/scale, same ground baseline within row, complete cape/feet fully within cell with generous transparent gutters. Every row must show subtle but real intentional redraws of the breathing/cloth shapes; not four identical copies. Left and right should have their appropriate anatomy and weapon placement. No background color, checkerboard, glow, gradients, cast shadow, vignette, smoke, words or extra frames.
walk: Production game sprite sheet for FalseMemory: EXACTLY 16 NEW WALK drawings in a strict 4 COLUMN x4 ROW grid, transparent background, no text. Use the user's blond 4x4 WALK example (first input image) as the EXACT pose/camera/sequence guide: reproduce its four-direction walking logic, but replace the blond/light-clothes character with the APPROVED dark-haired black-armored burgundy-caped FalseMemory hero from the later reference images. The most recent image is the completed four-direction Idle sheet: match its hero identity, proportions, armor, hair, scarf/cape, sword placement, pixel density and scale. Do not output Idle again. ROW1 DOWN facing camera; ROW2 LEFT profile; ROW3 RIGHT profile; ROW4 UP actual back view showing rear hair/cape and no face. Each row must show FOUR sequential frames of WALKING IN PLACE: column1 a close-legged passing step with one foot lifted slightly and arms passing; column2 clear contact with character LEFT leg forward, RIGHT back and opposite arm swing; column3 the OTHER close-legged passing step with opposite supporting leg and small different shoulder/cape contour (not a duplicate of column1); column4 opposite clear contact with RIGHT leg forward, LEFT back and reversed arm swing. In both contact frames show feet separated along the walking direction; for side views show obvious left-right stride separation like the user's example. Boots advance and lift in alternation, knees bend, arms swing opposite legs, slight weight shift and restrained cape follow-through. Keep all head/armor/weapon details stable. Do not change who leads randomly within a cycle. All four images must be distinct meaningful phases. No additional frames or directions. Fixed camera and full-body framing, same scale throughout, generous transparent gutters and complete feet/capes inside each square cell, common support-foot ground baseline. Detailed Dark Fantasy pixel art, crisp clean pixel clusters, quiet muted colors. NOT 3D/painting/photorealism. The hero is NOT blond and NOT dressed in grey cloth. No labels, checkerboard, background haze, glow, shadow, smoke or extra characters. Prefer a large square sheet around1536x1536 so each figure retains detail.
